howToSteps.text: Start by naming the exact ceremony, ritual purpose, and preferred date window so Navdhya can interpret the request without guesswork.
howToSteps.name: Define the ritual request clearly

howToSteps.text: Include the city, language, sampradaya or regional custom, and participant details that may affect pandit matching or ceremony structure.
howToSteps.name: Add family and regional preferences

howToSteps.text: Mention whether samagri, muhurta input, live-stream support, or space-preparation help is needed so the brief reaches the right workflow.
howToSteps.name: List support and material needs

howToSteps.text: Note building access, timing limits, elder support needs, and any special ceremony sensitivities that must be planned around early.
howToSteps.name: Capture logistical constraints

howToSteps.text: Read the request once as if you were the assigned pandit and confirm that the ritual goal, expectations, and logistics are all explicit before sending it to Navdhya.
howToSteps.name: Review and submit the brief
